title: Acme Account Journey: Customer 360 for sales
description: Sam Reyes's Globex account page — KPI header, parallel Platform Search tiles, journey summary, and saved prompts — built two ways with Platform Search+Chat and Platform Agents.
prerequisites: A Glean instance with the Acme corpus indexed (see acme-corpus/)
Path A: a Glean API token with SEARCH and CHAT scopes
Path B: a Glean API token with SEARCH and AGENTS scopes (tiles still use Platform Search)
X_GLEAN_INCLUDE_EXPERIMENTAL=true (Platform Search, Chat, and Agents are experimental)
Path B: an Account Brief agent in Agent Builder; set GLEAN_AGENT_ID server-side

demoQueries.query: What's the status of the Globex renewal?
demoQueries.expectedBehavior: Answer cites sales-globex-renewal-status with renewal date 2026-09-30, on-track status, and open items (DPA / procurement).
Synthesis cites account notes and renewal (ARR, seats, owner Sam Reyes, renewal date).

demoQueries.query: What are the renewal risks for Globex?
demoQueries.expectedBehavior: Cites renewal open items; overall risk stated as low is a fact from the corpus, not missing evidence.

codeAssets.description: Path A — parallel Platform Search tiles + Platform Chat synthesis

steps.title: Set credentials
steps.description: Fill in GLEAN_API_TOKEN and GLEAN_INSTANCE. Set GLEAN_USE_FIXTURE=true for contract-only verification without live Platform handlers.

steps.title: Verify
steps.description: Runs fixture-mode contract verification for /api/account tiles and the three demo chat queries.

codeAssets.description: Path B — Platform Agents createRun for prescriptive account briefs

steps.title: Set credentials
steps.description: Fill in GLEAN_API_TOKEN, GLEAN_INSTANCE, and GLEAN_AGENT_ID (Account Brief agent). Use GLEAN_USE_FIXTURE=true until the agent exists.

steps.title: Verify
steps.description: Fixture-first verification. Optional: npm run verify:live checks agents.get / getSchemas before createRun.

steps.title: Pick a path
steps.description: Path A (Platform Search + Chat) builds an open-ended explorable dashboard: parallel search.query tiles and POST /api/chat for journey summary and saved prompts. Path B (Platform Agents) keeps the same page UX but runs synthesis through glean.agents.createRun against a template Account Brief agent.

aiPrompt:
Build the Acme Account Journey (Customer 360) following
https://developers.glean.com/cookbook/customer-360

1. Ask me which path: (A) Platform Search + Chat or (B) Platform Agents.
   Build the one I pick. Do NOT use Client API chat.create, client.search.query,
   or client.agents.run.
2. Single Globex account page for Sam Reyes: KPI header (ARR $840k, renewal
   2026-09-30, risk low, 1,200 seats), three source tiles, journey summary,
   saved-prompt buttons (Customer summary, Renewal risks), drill-in chat.
3. Path A: parallel glean.search.query for account notes / renewal / security
   tiles; journey + prompts + follow-ups via server-side POST /api/chat with
   { input, stream: false, store: true } and X_GLEAN_INCLUDE_EXPERIMENTAL.
   Parse output_text + annotations[].sources[]. Keep the token server-side.
4. Path B: same page UX; synthesis via glean.agents.createRun({ messages,
   stream: false }, GLEAN_AGENT_ID). Fixture-first verify; document Agent
   Builder Account Brief prereq. Failure UX if agent missing/unauthorized.
5. Empty tiles show "no recent activity". Low renewal risk is a corpus fact,
   not missing evidence.
6. Style as Acme Corp: teal #0E8C84, Inter.
7. Verify with the three demo queries against acme-corpus Globex docs.
llmContext: Platform-only recipe. Search: glean.search.query -> POST /api/search, results[].title/url/snippets (string[]). Chat: fetch POST /api/chat (until glean.chat.create ships); request {input, stream:false, store:true}; response output[].content[] type=output_text with annotations[].sources[]. Agents: glean.agents.createRun(request, agentId) -> POST /api/agents/{agent_id}/runs; stream:false returns PlatformAgentRunWaitResponse synchronously (no polling); messages use role USER|GLEAN_AI and content[{text,type:text}]. Experimental opt-in via X_GLEAN_INCLUDE_EXPERIMENTAL. Do NOT teach glean.client.chat.create, glean.client.search.query, or glean.client.agents.run. Tokens server-side only. Corpus: sales-globex-account-notes, sales-globex-renewal-status, sales-globex-security-questionnaire. Persona: sam.reyes@acme.example.com.
